extracted.name: Overnight Chia Oats
extracted.description: This 4-ingredient overnight chia oat recipe features almond milk, rolled oats, banaan, and chia seeds for a healthy and hearty. grab-and-go breakfast.
instruction_lines: Combine almond milk, oats, mashed banana, and chia seeds in a 1-pint jar. Top with a lid: shake until well combined.
Refrigerate until chia seeds have swelled and oats mixture is thick and gel-like, 8 hours to overnight.
